a2-111.title: Communicative Challenge: What Can You Do?
a2-111.scenario: On the way to the local office to register her new address, Károly asks Meg what she can do. You (Meg) can drive and cook, but you play the piano badly.
a2-111.prompt: Tell Károly which skills you have, and which one you are bad at.
cues: Say which skill you are bad at
a2-111.target: Tudok vezetni és főzni, de rosszul tudok zongorázni.
a2-111.english: I can drive and cook, but I play the piano badly.
a2-111.canDo: I can talk about a wider range of skills using tud, like driving, cooking, and playing an instrument.

a2-112.title: Communicative Challenge: I Can't Drive
a2-112.scenario: Károly asks Meg to drive them to the office. You (Meg) can't drive because you are still learning, and today you wouldn't be able to drive anyway because it is raining.
a2-112.prompt: Tell Károly that you can't drive because you are still learning, and that today you can't drive because it is raining.
cues: Say you can't drive and why
Say that today it isn't possible to drive and why
a2-112.target: Nem tudok vezetni, mert még tanulok. Ma nem lehet vezetni, mert esik az eső.
a2-112.english: I can't drive, because I'm still learning. Today you can't drive, because it's raining.
a2-112.canDo: I can say I'm not able to do something and explain why using nem tud + infinitive and mert.

a2-113.title: Communicative Challenge: Is It Possible?
a2-113.scenario: At the local office Meg asks the clerk what is possible. You (Meg) ask whether you can park here and whether you can pay by card here.
a2-113.prompt: Ask the clerk if it is possible to park here and if it is possible to pay by card.
cues: Ask whether it is possible to park
Ask whether it is possible to pay by card
a2-113.target: Elnézést, lehet itt parkolni? Lehet itt kártyával fizetni?
a2-113.english: Excuse me, is it possible to park here? Is it possible to pay by card here?
a2-113.canDo: I can ask whether something is possible using Lehet + infinitive, and answer with Igen, lehet / Nem, nem lehet.

a2-114.title: Communicative Challenge: Is It Allowed?
a2-114.scenario: At the office Meg asks the clerk whether photography is allowed, then points out to Károly a sign about smoking.
a2-114.prompt: Ask the clerk if it is allowed to take photographs here, then tell Károly that smoking is not allowed here.
cues: Say that smoking is not allowed
a2-114.target: Szabad itt fényképezni? Itt nem szabad dohányozni.
a2-114.english: Is it allowed to take photographs here? You must not smoke here.
a2-114.canDo: I can ask and say what's allowed by a rule using szabad + infinitive.

a2-115.title: Communicative Challenge: What Can We Do?
a2-115.scenario: After the office Károly asks Meg what they can do today. You (Meg) can cycle, it is possible to cycle in the park today, and it is allowed there.
a2-115.prompt: Tell Károly that you can cycle, that today it is possible in the park, and that it is allowed.
cues: Say you are able to cycle
Say it is possible and allowed in the park today
a2-115.target: Tudok biciklizni. Ma lehet a parkban biciklizni, és szabad is.
a2-115.english: I can cycle. Today it's possible to cycle in the park, and it's allowed too.
a2-115.canDo: I can combine tud, lehet, and szabad in one conversation about plans, choosing the right one for ability, possibility, or permission.

a2-115-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Rules and Skills
a2-115-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks Meg to help with the car. You (Meg) cook well, but you can't drive because you are still learning, and parking is not allowed here.
a2-115-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that you cook well but can't drive because you are still learning, and that you must not park here.
cues: Say what you do well and what you can't do
Say what is not allowed here
a2-115-consolidation.target: Jól tudok főzni, de nem tudok vezetni, mert még tanulok. Itt nem szabad parkolni.
a2-115-consolidation.english: I can cook well, but I can't drive, because I'm still learning. You must not park here.
a2-115-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about skills using tud, and grade them with jól/rosszul.
